alt: A layered reading corner with a small potted plant on shelves, lit by warm natural light from the side, with books, a brass sconce, and soft textiles; the scene repeated five times with different wall and surface finishes.
text:
a plant stays still while the room keeps shifting.

notice how the brass sconce catches light differently when the wall changes color.

five rooms, one plant. same shelf, same objects. five completely different rooms.

#interiorjourneys #plantedlight #quietgrowth #layeredlight #wallsandshadow
note: Too plain again — the same problem as the previous draft: no layering, no tension in the light, nothing that rewards a second look.
